meta.name: merge-worktree
meta.description: 워크트리 브랜치를 main으로 squash-merge + conventional commit 자동 생성. codex-swarm 워크트리 자동 인식. '머지해', 'merge worktree', '워크트리 머지', '결과 수집', 'squash merge' 요청에 사용.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动合并工作树分支到主干,并生成规范提交记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在多个工作树分支上开发,需要一键合并到主线。
copy.tagline_en: Merge worktree branches into main with auto-generated conventional commit messages.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop in multiple worktree branches and need to merge them into the main branch easily.

howto.what: 把工作树分支的改动 squash 合并到目标分支（默认 main 或 master），按功能/修复/重构等类型自动撰写规范提交信息并提交，随后清理工作树与分支、汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你说“머지해”“merge worktree”“결과 수집”等指令，或 codex-swarm 流程进行到“结果收集”步骤时自动触发。需处于工作树中且工作区干净。

say.note: 自动 squash 合并到 main 并提交
指定合并到 develop 分支

howto.what_en: Squash-merges the worktree branch into the target branch (default main or master), auto-writes a conventional commit message based on the dominant change type, commits, then removes the worktree and branch, and reports the result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "머지해", "merge worktree", "결과 수집", etc., or automatically during codex-swarm Step 10 ('result collection'). Requires being inside a worktree with a clean working tree.

say_en.note: Squash-merges the current worktree into main and auto-commits.
Use develop as the merge target instead of main.
